strict_demarcation_guardrail.alphagenome_2_reference: Gayoso et al., 'AlphaGenome 2 predicts regulatory activity and variant effects across cell states', Google DeepMind (2026)

gate_g4_classical_baseline.method: Precomputed CPIC / GENCODE v46 / AlphaGenome Atlas AVI Lookup Table

CYP2C19_star17_rs12248560.cpic_or_literature_annotation: 5'-upstream promoter rapid/ultrarapid metabolizer allele (SSRI/tricyclic SMR dosing context)

CYP2C19_star2_rs4244285.cpic_or_literature_annotation: Exon-5 cryptic splice-donor activation loss-of-function allele (antidepressant/clopidogrel SMR context)

CYP2D6_star4_rs3892097.cpic_or_literature_annotation: Intron-3/exon-4 canonical splice-acceptor loss-of-function allele (codeine/tramadol/anticholinergic SMR context)

IL6_promoter_rs1800795.cpic_or_literature_annotation: Canonical proximal promoter regulatory polymorphism upstream of IL6 TSS

IL6_exon1_donor_hotspot.cpic_or_literature_annotation: Top AVI saturation-mutagenesis splice-donor hotspot in IL6 601-bp promoter/exon-1 scan

FKBP5_intron2_GRE_rs1360780.cpic_or_literature_annotation: Intron-2 glucocorticoid-response element linked to stress-associated CpG methylation & HPA feedback

NR3C1_BclI_rs41423247.cpic_or_literature_annotation: Common intronic glucocorticoid receptor sensitivity polymorphism downstream of exon 2

NR3C1_exon1_donor_hotspot.cpic_or_literature_annotation: Top AVI saturation-mutagenesis hotspot across NR3C1 CpG promoter / exon-1 island (2,403 SNVs scanned)

gate_g4_classical_baseline.honest_comparison_verdict: For known CPIC star alleles (CYP2C19*2, CYP2C19*17, CYP2D6*4, CYP2D6*41), deterministic curated allele tables resolve metabolizer phenotypes in <1 ms; AlphaGenome 2's value lies in de-novo non-coding/intronic variant interpretation, primary-cell CpG methylation deltas, and condition-specific distal enhancer-gene (E2G) attribution across unseen or rare cell states.
